{"id":"JMAP-lu95.7","title":"metadata-04: refresh -02 citations and section numbers","description":"Refresh draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 citations to -04 across the repo.

The repo has 137 "metadata-02" sites in 70 files, outside target/ and .beads/: the metadata-types/server/client crates, the WithMetadata docs in the mail, sharing, chat, contacts, calendars, filenode and tasks clients, the *-types crates, and AGENTS.md (lines 86-88, 127).

Do this after the behavior beads above, so each comment cites -04 for code that actually implements -04.

-04 renumbered sections, so a plain s/-02/-04/ leaves wrong section numbers:
- /query moved from §3.5 to §3.6 (because §3.4 /copy was inserted; /queryChanges moved from §3.4 to §3.5). About 109 lines mention "§3.5" together with metadata. Some are RFC 9670/RFC 8620 §3.5 cites, so change only those that reference the metadata draft.
- Account Delegation moved from §4.1 to §4.2; §4.1 is now "The maySetMetadata Right" (3 sites).
- crate-jmap-metadata-client/src/lib.rs §2.4/§2.5 cites for /changes were already wrong in -02 (it is §3.3). Fix them to §3.3.
- Sections that kept their numbers: §1.2.1 capability, §2.1 namespaces, §2.2 state, §3.1 /get, §3.2 /set, §3.3 /changes.
- Stale prose to update while there: "opted-in" (the -04 term is "listed data type"); "Namespaces Removed Mid-Lifetime" (§2.1.1 is now "Data in Unsupported Namespaces").

This is comment and doc text only, with no code changes. Do not touch the jmap-chat-spec scene citations (already -04).
